_description: Produced by: Phase 1 ingestion module. Consumed by: Phase 2 profiling, frontend dashboard, experiment manager.

dataset_id._description: Unique internal UUID for the dataset. Primary reference for all phases.

display_id._description: Human-readable dataset identifier for UI display and reports.

status._description: Registration status after Phase 1 validation pipeline completes.

container_type._description: File format container type (NOT ML modality - that's Phase 2).

upload_timestamp._description: UTC timestamp of upload completion for audit logs.

file_size_bytes._description: Original file size for resource planning and storage management.

sha256._description: SHA-256 hash for integrity verification and duplicate detection.

storage_path._description: Path to immutable raw dataset storage. Consumed by Phase 2 loader.

is_duplicate._description: Whether SHA-256 matches existing dataset. Triggers UI warning.

duplicate_of._description: Dataset ID of duplicate if is_duplicate=true.

rejection_reason._description: Reason if status != REGISTERED. Used for error display.
